responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module specifies the exported scope-management and statement-list API implemented by m2block.cc. It documents the gm2 services for pushing and popping global or function scopes, recording declarations, preserving constants and types from GC, creating labels, and managing statement lists, so Modula-2-side code can drive GCC BLOCK construction through a stable foreign interface.
same_name_distinction: This is the Modula-2 definition-module surface for m2block, publishing the scope and statement-list operations to Modula-2 code with Modula-2 signatures. Unlike m2block.h it serves the foreign interface from the Modula-2 side, and unlike m2block.cc it contains no binding-level implementation.
